basis: Complement-mediated thrombotic microangiopathy defines renal injury, hemolytic anemia and thrombocytopenia; secondary hypertension adds no separate axis.
Neurodevelopmental impairment is common across 11p deletion syndromes; ocular, renal and skeletal abnormalities depend on the deleted interval.
Fibroblastic soft-tissue neoplasm; pleural, peritoneal and other organ sites vary across this umbrella. Rare paraneoplastic effects excluded.
Mesenchymal soft-tissue sarcoma, usually in deep extremity tissues; despite its name, synovial origin is not established. Other primary sites vary.
Hereditary TTR protein-deposition disorder with neuropathy; nephropathy 80-99%, cardiac disease 30-79%; ocular involvement omitted under four-axis cap.
Disease of spinal nerve roots causing sensory loss, weakness and radicular pain; underlying spinal disorders are separate conditions.
Trophoblastic neoplasia primarily involves gestational or gonadal reproductive tissues; no covered organ is consistently involved across the group.
Hereditary skin and hair disorder with poikiloderma and acral keratoses in 4/4 patients; no supported extracutaneous injury.
Inflammation of the uvula involves oral and oropharyngeal mucosa. Infection or a specific immune mechanism is not established for every case.
Benign adenomyoma confined to the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Neonatal epilepsy is defined by recurrent cerebral seizures; development is typically normal and seizures usually remit in infancy.
Glycosylation immunodeficiency with defining hepatopathy; intellectual disability/seizures 6/11; leukopenia 6/11 and splenic involvement omitted under cap.
Mitochondrial respiratory-chain metabolic disorder; encephalopathy and developmental impairment commonly exceed 30%; muscle, liver and heart injury vary by subtype.
Riboflavin deficiency/transport disorder is metabolic; consistent direct maternal organ injury is not established. Infant manifestations are not assigned to the mother.
Inherited retinal dystrophy with progressive photoreceptor degeneration and visual loss; associated anterior segment abnormalities remain within the ocular axis.
Defined as nonsyndromic intellectual disability with developmental and speech impairment; the gene alone does not establish systemic metabolic disease.
Mesomelic skeletal dysplasia with frequent synostoses and limb deformities; skin dimples do not imply skin damage; intellectual disability and strabismus are under 30%.
Malignant neoplasm originating in peripheral nerve sheath; melanin and psammoma bodies do not establish skin or metabolic involvement.
Skeletal malformations and characteristic macroglossia/cleft palate; renal dysplasia and VSD annotated 80-99%; organomegaly alone does not establish damage.
Defined by tongue/oral pain and burning; pain alone does not establish additional neurologic organ damage.
Inherited TCA-cycle metabolic defects; encephalopathy and neurodevelopmental impairment commonly exceed 30% across symptomatic forms; retinal disease is subtype-specific.
Pontine and cerebellar developmental disease with movement abnormalities; visual impairment alone does not establish intrinsic ocular injury.
Inherited retinal disease caused by PDE6A variants; no supported extraocular organ involvement.
Generalized skeletal hyperostosis causes facial nerve palsy and sensorineural hearing loss, each 30-79%; optic atrophy frequency is insufficiently established.
MYL3-related hypertrophic cardiomyopathy directly affects myocardium; arrhythmias and heart failure remain within the cardiovascular axis.
